svg.aria-label: Top: input with defined interference, known model, and 21-point quadratic Savitzky–Golay output. Red points meet a 0.3 mV prominence and 100-sample separation. Below: errors relative to the model at different window lengths; sampling interval 0.02 s, mirrored boundaries.
